author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Fixed the Trip/Contact auto-fill from v1.1.0, which never actually worked: it called a GET endpoint with the id appended to the path, but v3 has no such route (nor any 'get one activity by id' endpoint at all) — switched to the real convention (POST, operator in the path, args as a JSON array body) and v3.activity.list scoped across Trips IHS's phases. Verified end-to-end against a real trip. Also rotated the embedded API key: the previous value was a raw login session token (not a real User API Key) that had been committed in this public repo — replaced with a properly-issued, named key ('Customer Feedback Form (public)').
